results.title: Ikaw, Kelan?
results.overview: A short film by J.E. Tiglao

results.title: Sea Star
results.overview: Personal tragedy prompts an elderly Black man to take his first swimming lesson in Tyler Mckenzie Evans’ profound observation of the Herculean strength needed to move through grief in the face of unshakeable fears and generational trauma.

results.title: Kis Kisko Pyaar Karoon 2
results.overview: Mohan wants to marry the love of his life, Sania, but destiny has a madcap plan! He ends up marrying three women of different religions and chaos follows.

results.title: Sunblasting
results.overview: The introduction to a feature film in progress called Punas (continuation of Puna, from 2006, a work made in Jujuy by the same filmmaker). Sunblasting explores the Andean world in connection with the historical and geographical. A framework in which beliefs, rituals and contemporaneity are superimposed.

results.title: Twenty Twenty
results.overview: A brutal night shift forces a doctor to choose between medical protocol and her humanity.

results.title: Im Schatten der Angst - Der Skorpion
results.original_title: Im Schatten der Angst - Der Skorpion
results.overview: Is a murderer always a murderer? Karla Eckhardt supports easing measures for convicted murderer Anton Lisky. But as soon as she is released, Lisky's work colleague is killed. Was Karla wrong?

results.title: The Activist
results.overview: A young man infiltrates a radical neo-Nazi group to find the killer of his LGBT+ activist boyfriend.

results.title: Ritas
results.overview: It explores Rita Lee's personal life and her creative process, revealing her musical talent and her ability to transform on stage. Rita herself guides the narrative through past interviews she gave throughout her career and current testimonies.

results.title: The Fawn
results.overview: Trapped in a surreal landscape, a woman discovers she is the sacrifice in a ritual meant to awaken something unspeakable.

results.title: Divorced
results.overview: A man spirals into his imagination when he struggles to make sense of an impending divorce, and the loss of love.

results.title: Bambino
results.overview: A pair of freshman baseball players, desperate to prove themselves to their new team, get roped into a long-standing prank: stealing their rival school's beloved mascot. But as the night drags on and tensions rise, what seemed like a simple initiation turns into an unpredictable, high-stakes mess.

results.title: Forsaken Mercenary
results.overview: He's the deadliest man in the galaxy with a secret that could be his undoing.

results.title: BELHELL
results.overview: Between pushing, sweating and the suffocating heat of a crowded bus in Belém do Pará, Fulana realizes that this is not just another ordinary day in the life of a person from Pará.

results.title: Christmas at Fields Ranch
results.overview: When city broker Daisy inherits a ranch before Christmas, she’s torn between selling it or keeping it. Reconnecting with an old crush, she falls in love with the property and must choose between her career and her heart before the season ends.

results.title: Politickin'
results.overview: In a sparked classroom seminar, students discuss the true "weapons" of resiliency.

results.title: Everyone Knows Every Juan
results.overview: The Sevilla siblings reunite at their ancestral home a year after the passing of their matriarch. What begins as an obligatory gathering quickly spirals into a storm of revelations, grudges, and laughter, exposing the fragile ties that bind them.

results.title: Altarpiece Artists
results.overview: The art of votive offerings is fading, and with it, its creators, the retableros. We will witness the work of some of these last artisans, masters of a craft deeply rooted in tradition, religious and social identity in Mexico; they will tell us about their lives, their work, and their future.
